:::{#thm-matmul-assoc}
#### Matrix multiplication is associative

For an $m \times k$ matrix $\matr{A}$,
a $k \times l$ matrix $\matr{B}$,
and an $l \times n$ matrix $\matr{C}$:

$$
\underbrace{(\matr{A}\matr{B})\matr{C}}_{m \times n}
= \underbrace{\matr{A}(\matr{B}\matr{C})}_{m \times n}
$$

:::

::: proof

Entry $(i, j)$ of each side, from @def-matrix-mult:

$$
\ba
\sb{(\matr{A}\matr{B})\matr{C}}_{ij}
&= \sumto{t}{l} (\matr{A}\matr{B})_{it}\, c_{tj}
&& \text{(definition of } (\matr{A}\matr{B})\matr{C} \text{)}
\\
&= \sumto{t}{l} \paren{\sumto{s}{k} a_{is}\, b_{st}} c_{tj}
&& \text{(definition of } \matr{A}\matr{B} \text{)}
\\
&= \sumto{s}{k} a_{is} \paren{\sumto{t}{l} b_{st}\, c_{tj}}
&& \text{(distribute and swap the finite sums)}
\\
&= \sumto{s}{k} a_{is}\, (\matr{B}\matr{C})_{sj}
&& \text{(definition of } \matr{B}\matr{C} \text{)}
\\
&= \sb{\matr{A}(\matr{B}\matr{C})}_{ij}
&& \text{(definition of } \matr{A}(\matr{B}\matr{C}) \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
